prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Cedarbell:normalize Airport Capacity Plan;Capacity Assessment Module:Airport Acceptance Rate. Blueharbor→adapter/Foxglove:Calculated Takeoff Time,Target Off Block Time,arrival-opportunities;freeze→Pushback Window Token;changes:reasons/Copperfin-review. Capacity>preferences;protected>commercial>discretionary;Ground Delay Program:equitable. Orchard:weather/provenance/override-validation;Storm Cell Snapshot:uncertainty. Quartzline→Blueharbor:Stand Tow Request Form;Brindle/Airport Duty Manager:conflicts;Runway Inspection Note precedes endorsement;North Runway Meter/South Runway Meter←capacities. Performance Analytics Warehouse:failures/freshness-breaches/corrections/ownership-conflicts. Training:Aircraft Operator Representative:intent/time-changes;Ground Handling Dispatcher:Handling Resource Planner;Halcyon:Business Rules Registry;Network Operations Liaison/Airspace Sector Planner:regional/sector/network;mandatory visual/radio/local-safety checks. Readiness Gate 2:exchange/adapters/Orchard nondisruptive;Readiness Gate 3:Foxglove/Ironleaf/Skylark/Emberline/Nightjar procedures. Recovery

New part:
S970: The Data Governance Steward is accountable for data quality rules, retention policy, access controls, and permitted operational use of shared data.
S971: The System Support Engineer is accountable for technical availability, fault response, configuration control, and coordinated restoration of the operational services.
S972: The Regional Flow Platform is the primary operational environment for the common regional plan, while the Airport CDM Portal is the primary airport coordination environment.
S973: The Demand Prediction Service, Capacity Assessment Module, and Sector Load Monitor provide planning evidence, but accountable human authorities remain responsible for operational decisions.
S974: The Common Situation Display is the shared baseline for time-critical coordination and should be kept consistent with the Regional Flow Platform and Airport CDM Portal.
S975: The Collaborative Decision Log is the authoritative record of significant decisions, objections, approvals, and operational rationale during coordinated operations.
S976: Calculated Takeoff Time and Target Off Block Time commitments should be treated as executable operating constraints unless they are revised through the agreed coordination process.
S977: Ground Delay Program decisions, Tactical Regulation Proposal review, and Airport Acceptance Rate changes should be visible to affected participants before they are applied whenever operational time permits.
S978: Information-sharing duties include timely maintenance of the Flight Intent Message, Airport Capacity Plan, and other agreed planning data needed for demand and capacity balancing.
S979: The Flight Data Exchange, Airline Interface Adapter, Surface Surveillance Adapter, and Weather Ingest Gateway must be operated with monitored data quality thresholds and clear fallback procedures.
S980: The Slot Allocation Engine, Departure Metering Service, Arrival Regulation Console, Tower Sequence Manager, and Ramp Movement Board must use the approved rules recorded in the Business Rules Registry.
S981: The Identity Access Service and Audit Event Ledger must support traceability, least-privilege access, and after-action accountability for all operationally significant changes.
S982: The Performance Analytics Warehouse and Post Operations Report should be used to measure compliance, delay outcomes, capacity use, and the effectiveness of collaborative decisions.
S983: Governance should favor transparent decision making, timely challenge by affected parties, documented resolution of disputes, and continuous improvement through training, exercises, and post-operations review.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
